Test Case Title: Search with an empty location field
Module: GoodWeatherKM
Priority: Low

Preconditions:
- The GoodWeatherKM Android app is launched
- The initial alert has been confirmed by tapping "OK"
- The device is connected to the internet

Test Steps:
1. Tap the "Search" button.
2. Wait for the "Search location" edit text field to be visible.
3. Leave the "Search location" field empty.
4. Observe the screen.
5. Type "M" (a single character) in the field.
6. Observe the options shown.

Expected Result:
- The empty field does not return or select any location and the app does not crash.
- The app handles the single-character entry without crashing and does not change the current location unless an option is tapped. (Generated from Manual Test Case)
